title: 5.2.17 Lab: Reaching the Goal
description: Use the finished scene's distance check to win once with delete(). Auto-graded.

steps.title: Guard the check
steps.instructions: At the bottom of draw(), add `if (goal) { }`. The next two steps go inside its braces, so the check only runs while the goal still exists.
hints: 5.2.16 Worked Example: The Finished Scene wraps its whole win check in `if (goal) { ... }`. Yours has the same shape.

steps.title: Measure the distance
steps.instructions: Inside `if (goal)`, work out how far the player is from the goal: `dx` is the gap left to right (`player.x - goal.x`), `dy` is the gap up and down, and the distance is the square root of `dx * dx + dy * dy`. Keep it in a variable such as `dist`.
hints: This is the distance formula from 3.1.7 Worked Example: Refactoring calcDistance. `Math.sqrt(...)` and `** 0.5` both take the square root.
Three lines, as in 5.2.16: `const dx = player.x - goal.x;`, then the same for `dy`, then `const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);`.

steps.title: Win once
steps.instructions: Still inside `if (goal)`, when the distance is less than 25, log a win message, call `goal.delete()`, then set `goal` to `null`. Run it, move with `a` and `d` (jump with the space bar) and walk into the gold block: the message prints once and the goal is gone for good. Right after the first drop the player makes a few small hops before it settles, and for that half second the space bar does nothing: the jump only fires while the player is touching the ground.
hints: 5.2.15 Reading: Cleanup and Delete deletes a sprite and then sets its variable to `null`, so the guard is false from then on.
`if (dist < 25) { ... }` holds the three lines: the `console.log`, `goal.delete();` and `goal = null;`.

requirements.title: Guard the check on the goal still existing
requirements.description: The win check is wrapped in if (goal) so it stops running once the goal is gone. Help: 5.2.16 (Worked Example: The Finished Scene)

requirements.title: Compute the distance and test it
requirements.description: The distance between player and goal is worked out from their positions (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), ** 0.5, Math.hypot(dx, dy), dist(...), or player.distanceTo(goal)) and is what the if tests: dist < 25. Help: 5.2.16 (Worked Example: The Finished Scene)

requirements.title: Delete the goal on arrival
requirements.description: When the player reaches the goal, goal.delete() is called. Help: 5.2.15 (Reading: Cleanup and Delete)

requirements.title: Clear the goal variable
requirements.description: After deleting, goal is set to null so the win check can never fire twice. Help: 5.2.15 (Reading: Cleanup and Delete)
